example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় বড় কথা বলে, কিন্তু কিছু করে না।
এটা বড় কথা যে তুমি আমাদের সাথে আছো।
example_sentences_in_english: He always indulges in big talk but does nothing.
It's a big deal that you are with us.
note: The idiom can convey both boastful exaggeration and emphasis on something significant depending on context.
